description: Replace the sign-DC finishing orthonormalizer for shape 11 with a CholeskyQR2 finish instead of the current 2x Newton-Schulz: a sibling proved the 2 tf32x3_delta NS finishes (~7ms) are load-bearing and irreducible to 1 (fin=1 needs it=16, slower than it=10+fin2), but never tried a STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT orthonormalizer; another sibling proved the library CholeskyQR2 (Gram->potrf->trsm + the fused add_shifted_diag glue) is fast and library-optimal. Mechanism: swap the 2-pass NS finish for a CholeskyQR2 orthonormalization of the assembled sign-DC eigenvector basis (reusing the in-tree _lr_cholesky_qr2 / fused-shift machinery), which reaches machine-precision orthogonality in 2 potrf+trsm passes potentially cheaper than 2 full n*n NS matmul passes. Targets redundant-work / compute-throughput on the finish stage; keep the residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback + orthogonality-edge calibration, route guarded per shape.

CQR2 finish (2-pass, gram=3xTF32/3xTF32, shift=1e-6) replaces 2x NS on shape-11 sign-DC. SIGNDC_TIME: finish 6.68ms->22.39ms, orth 1e-4->5.3e-6 (gate 5.49e-3), eigr 0.0035->0.0048, 0/640 fallback. shape11 77505->92247us. CQR2 machine-precision-clean but full-rank n=512 potrf+trsm x2 ~3.3x costlier than 6 (512^3) tf32 bmm. 39/39 valid. Orth margin 1000x => fewer passes/cheaper Gram next.

1-pass CQR2 finish (gram=3xTF32, shift=1e-6). SIGNDC_TIME: finish 11.26ms (1-pass) vs 22.39ms (2-pass) vs 6.68ms (2x NS). orth 5.8e-5 (gate 5.49e-3, 85x margin), eigr 0.0053 (gate 0.0107), 0/640 fallback. shape11 77505->80968us. Geomean 27572.672us (+0.40% vs parent). 1 CQR2 pass already machine-precision-clean but wide FP32 trsm on full-rank (640,512,512) RHS still ~1.7x the NS finish. inv-GEMM (K*K tri-inverse + tensor-core Q@L^-T) next.

1-pass CQR2 finish, plain-TF32 Gram: BREAKS orth gate. orth_max=0.006204 > gate 0.005493 -> nbad=640/640 (100% cuSOLVER fallback). shape11 283368us, geomean 30467us (+11%). Accuracy floor: 3xTF32 REQUIRED for the finish Gram even at kappa~1 (TF32 ~3e-4/op over n=512 col dot-products lands orth just over gate). Finish stage itself cheap (9.56ms) but mass fallback dominates.

Best CQR2 finish = 1-pass 3xTF32 (branch HEAD). Geomean 27590.538us (shape11 81123us), reproduces t2 within noise; shape3 (cond=2 dense512) unchanged 74436us so only shape11 hits this finish. Finish-cost MAP (shape11): 2x NS 6.68ms (orth 1e-4) < CQR2-1pass-3xTF32 11.26ms (orth 6e-5) < CQR2-2pass-3xTF32 22.39ms (orth 5e-6). CQR2 needs only 1 pass (kappa~1 basis), not 2/3. FP32-SIMT trsm on full-rank (640,512,512) RHS irreducible (nsys batch_trsm 17%); inv-GEMM no help (k=n), plain-TF32 Gram breaks gate. 2x NS stays cheaper for the full-rank finish. nsys: brief-97-trial-4-shape11-fecc88e72ae79b33bc726adbd9691a1a525cc8b0.nsys-rep

3-pass CQR2 finish (fills the map). SIGNDC_TIME shape11: finish 33.63ms, orth 4.6e-6 (diminishing vs 2-pass 5e-6), eigr 0.0048, 0/640 fallback. shape11 103200us, geomean 28109.812us. MAP: 2x NS 6.68ms(orth 1e-4) < CQR2-1pass 11.26ms(6e-5) < CQR2-2pass 22.39ms(5e-6) < CQR2-3pass 33.63ms(4.6e-6); ~+11ms/pass (potrf+FP32 trsm+Gram on full-rank 640x512x512). 2x NS beats even 1-pass CQR2. CQR2 needs only 1 pass to clear gate.

FINAL HEAD: best CQR2 finish (mode=cqr2, passes=1, gram=3xtf32, shift=1e-6). Full benchmark geomean 27588.771us (shape11 80988us), 39/39 valid, 0/640 fallback, no 'stream', -O3. Every non-shape-11 shape matches parent. VERDICT: 2x NS finish (6.68ms, parent 27461.817us) BEATS every CQR2 variant for the full-rank n=512 basis. CQR2 machine-precision in 1 pass (basis kappa~1) but ~11ms/pass because FP32-SIMT cuBLAS trsm on full-rank (640,512,512) RHS (nsys batch_trsm 17%) > 6 (512^3) tf32 tensor-core bmm of NS. inv-GEMM no help (k=n), plain-TF32 Gram breaks gate. nsys: brief-97-trial-6-shape11-71bb0167e4ae573af75cea516f127198fa124746.nsys-rep

Built + measured the CQR2 finish swap for shape-11's sign-DC (full-rank Q=640x512x512). MEASURED VERDICT: 2x Newton-Schulz finish (parent, 6.68ms, geomean 27461.817us) BEATS every CholeskyQR2 finish variant. Finish-cost map (shape11, orth gate 0.005493): 2x NS 6.68ms/orth~1e-4 < CQR2-1pass-3xTF32 11.26ms/orth 6e-5 < CQR2-2pass 22.39ms/orth 5e-6 < CQR2-3pass 33.63ms/orth 4.6e-6. CQR2 reaches machine-precision orthogonality in ONE pass (sign-DC basis enters kappa~1, so 1 pass suffices -- NOT 2 or 3), but each pass costs ~11ms because the FP32-SIMT cuBLAS trsm on the full-rank (640,512,512) RHS (nsys batch_trsm_left_kernel 17% of shape) is inherently costlier than the 6 (512^3) tf32 tensor-core bmm the NS finish uses. Two sub-levers proven dead: (a) inv-GEMM (K*K tri-inverse + tensor-core Q@L^-T) does NOT shrink the trsm here because k=n=512 (the inverse RHS is the same 512x512 size), and (b) plain-TF32 Gram BREAKS the orth gate -> orth 0.006204 > 0.005493 -> 100% cuSOLVER fallback (t3), so 3xTF32 Gram is mandatory even at kappa~1. Best CQR2 = 1-pass 3xTF32 = geomean 27588.771us (+0.46% vs parent), 39/39 valid, 0/640 fallback, no 'stream', -O3; branch HEAD 71bb0167e carries it. STILL OPEN under the finish objective: (1) the finish trsm+potrf is ~7.5% potrf + the trsm; a POTRF-FREE orthonormalizer via coupled Newton-Schulz for G^-1/2 (Denman-Beavers/Higham) on the k=n Gram would be bmm-only but is the same 512x512 bmm size as the NS finish -- untested whether its constant beats tf32x3_delta's 3 bmm/pass. (2) The bigger shape-11 levers are ELSEWHERE, not the finish: proj_cqr 21.3ms and mega_eigh 29.7ms dwarf the 6.68ms finish (finish is only ~8.7% of the 77ms shape). The proj_cqr stage ALSO runs a wide FP32-SIMT trsm (batch_trsm 10 instances) on the (2b,n,K=300) bases -- same trsm-floor question but there k=300<n so inv-GEMM COULD help (currently _SIGN_DC_CQR_INV_GEMM=False). (3) mega_eigh at 29.7ms is the single largest stage and untouched by this brief.
